author: (C.Agardh) J.Agardh, 1842

note.en: A delicate, inconspicuous red tuft that tangles among coarser seaweeds and was a rare epiphyte on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita.
note.es: Un mechón rojo delicado y poco visible que se enreda entre algas más gruesas y fue un epífito raro en el pasto de tortuga en Punta Cahuita.

evidence: Samper-Villarreal et al. 2008: rare on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita (also cited from Kemperman 1986)

sources.t: Samper-Villarreal, Bernecker & Wehrtmann 2008, Inventory of macroalgal epiphytes on Thalassia testudinum in Parque Nacional Cahuita, Revista de Biología Tropical 56 (Suppl. 4)

recWhy: Record: Samper-Villarreal et al. 2008: rare on turtle grass at Punta Cahuita (also cited from Kemperman 1986).
